headline: Disney Selling 50% A+E Stake To Hearst For More Than $1B
summary: The midsized cable TV network group, including A&E Network, History Channel, Lifetime, Vice TV and others, would now be 100% owned by Hearst. The deal is expected to be finalized at the same time as Disney's quarterly earnings release on August 5.

headline: NBCUniversal names new CFO ahead of spinoff
summary: NFL alum Christopher Halpin will take NBC’s top finance seat as it gears up for a split from its parent company Comcast.
